04 / BEHIND THE TIMELINE

I’m Satya Teja.
I find the story
in the footage.

I work across video editing, motion, and color, shaping footage into stories for brands and creators.

My focus is on what the viewer feels: where to hold a shot, when to cut, and how to make the final frame mean something.

THE PROCESS / SIMPLE BY DESIGN
01 — ALIGN

Find the story.

Share your goal, audience, footage, and references. We define the direction together.

02 — SHAPE

Build the first cut.

Story and pacing come first. Feedback helps refine the cut around your vision.

03 — FINISH

Make it feel complete.

Motion, color, and final polish. Deliverables shaped for the places your story will live.
